home.title: Research, organised.
home.description: A focused place for market research, your notes and the evidence behind them.
paragraphs: Keep working notes private, publish selected research and organise the files that support it. Your account, content and watchlist live together in one small application.
Public market snapshots are available on request. Every quote includes its source time; polling is limited, and source delays remain visible.
items: Save private notes and publish deliberately. Search your own research without exposing it to other accounts.
Store small images and PDFs with your account. Files are private until you explicitly publish them.
Find securities in a 5,000-symbol directory. Request quotes for up to 20 visible watchlist items at a time.

guide.title: A small workflow for better research.
guide.description: How public pages, private accounts, notes, evidence and market snapshots fit together.
paragraphs: Start with a question. Write down your hypothesis, the evidence that supports it and the conditions that would change your mind. Save it privately while the research is in progress.
Publish when you intend to share. A public note is readable without an account. Its author can update it or make it private again; previously downloaded public content cannot be recalled.
items: Sign in to work with your own notes, files and watchlist. Email addresses are login identifiers; email verification and password recovery by email are not provided in this edition.
PNG, JPEG, WebP and PDF uploads are limited to 2 MiB each, with 20 MiB and 50 files per account. Keep an original copy. Public images may be cached briefly; private files are not cached.

Quotes use a public source with unverified upstream latency. The watchlist is a research tool, with optional 60-second polling while the page is visible. No live trading or return guarantees are offered.
Accounts have a 100-note limit. Large imports, image processing and persistent market streams are outside this product's scope.
